subject: Discovery debrief + internal amplification plan — Meridian Health
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Gorton <agorton@meridianhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery debrief + internal amplification plan — Meridian Health

Alex — thanks for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same playbook. I captured the items Meridian called out and a short enablement pack for Alex to use with Maria/Finance and Dinesh/Security.

Recap (30-minute discovery):
- Primary use case: Triage + summarization for clinician notes across 3 outpatient clinics (~120k notes/mo).
- Decision criteria called out: accuracy on clinical entities, on-prem/VPC options, audit logs + retention controls, predictable per-token cost, and clear SLA for latency for real-time clinician workflows.
- Economic buyer: Maria Lopez (CFO) — cares about unit economics, headcount reduction, and predictable TCO.
- Security reviewer: Dinesh Patel (Head of InfoSec) — will require SOC 2 + architecture diagram + data flow for PHI handling.
- Procurement cadence: procurement team indicated a standard 30–45 day procurement window once MOPs and SOC2 evidence are received.

Immediate actions (owner / ETA):
1) Send SOC2 evidence summary + architecture diagram (Soojin) — attachment: soc2-evidence-summary.xlsx — ETA: 11/2 EOD.
2) Share ROI one-pager & TCO assumptions for nurse/clinician time savings (Soojin) — attachment: roi-onepager.pdf — ETA: 11/2.
3) Draft Mutual Action Plan and propose procurement kickoff (Ben + Soojin) — attachment: mutual-action-plan.docx — ETA: 11/3.
4) Schedule a short (30m) procurement + security sync that includes Dinesh and Maria (Alex to propose times) — target week of 11/9.

Champion enablement notes (for Alex):
- Simple opener for Finance: "With Redwood we expect to reduce manual chart summarization time by ~40%, model-driven QC reduces downstream billing adjustments, and the predictable per-token pricing helps model headcount replacement scenarios into a three-year TCO."
- Quick security reassurance: "We can run models in a VPC/on-prem option; our platform provides audit logs and configurable retention for PHI — I'll circulate a SOC2 evidence summary and architecture diagram for your team."
- Negotiation levers to surface early: committed throughput for latency SLOs (Dedicated pool) vs hosted with fallback, and optional longer-term reserved discounts.

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (demo highlights), soc2-evidence-summary.xlsx, roi-onepager.pdf, mutual-action-plan.docx

Next step: Alex to propose 2x times for a procurement/security kickoff and confirm Maria's availability for a 20-minute finance readout.

Thanks — Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
redwoodinference.com

From: Alex Gorton <agorton@meridianhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2026 09:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery debrief + internal amplification plan — Meridian Health

Soojin — thanks for the clear recap and the materials. A couple quick clarifications from Maria and Dinesh after our internal sync: 

1) Maria asked for a 3-year TCO scenario that shows staffing delta and break-even at 18/24/36 months — can your ROI sheet include headcount assumptions we can tweak?
2) Dinesh would like the architecture diagram to show de-identification steps and where audit logs are stored/accessed. He also asked whether Redwood has a policy for vulnerability scans and contractually required breach notifications.
3) Procurement: we usually require a master services agreement (MSA) and an execution-ready SOW. If you can send a mutual action plan that maps to an MSA + SOW timeline, that will speed our internal approvals.

Proposed times for procurement/security kickoff: 11/10 10:00am PT or 11/11 2:00pm PT. Maria is available for a 20-minute finance readout on 11/12 11:00am PT.

I'll review the soc2 pack today and get back with any follow-ups. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Alex
Director of Digital Transformation | Meridian Health
agorton@meridianhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-4488

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Gorton <agorton@meridianhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Discovery debrief + internal amplification plan — Champion talk tracks & materials

Team — forwarding Alex's note. Below is a short "champion kit" I want us to use and share with Alex for Maria/Dinesh prep. I'm attaching the ROI one-pager and the SOC2 summary now. Please review the suggested talk tracks and call out anything we should change before Alex shares with his execs.

Champion kit (one-pagers + suggested phrasing):
- Finance / Maria (ROI focus):
  • Headline: "Predictable TCO and measurable clinician time savings"
  • Talking points: "Expected 40% reduction in time to summarize; projected FTE equivalence = 2.4 full-time clinicians at current volume; three-year savings > $420k (modelled)."
  • Ask: "If the numbers look reasonable, propose a 20-minute readout with Maria and a follow-up to align on the SOW scope."

- Security / Dinesh (compliance + architecture):
  • Headline: "PHI-safe deployment options and audit-first controls"
  • Talking points: "We support private VPC and on-prem variants; audit logs, configurable retention windows, and per-request metadata capture for traceability."
  • Docs to send: SOC2 summary, architecture diagram, vulnerability scan policy (will follow).

- Procurement / Legal:
  • Headline: "Execution-ready MSA + mapped SOW + clear milestones"
  • Talking points: "We can provide an MSA template, propose standard 60-day payment terms or flexible net-30 for pilots; include an optional dedicated pool add-on for latency SLOs."

Coaching notes for Alex (do use):
- Keep the finance ask tangible: show per-visit time saved and the direct cost offset (salary assumptions in the ROI sheet).
- For security, lead with deployment option and auditability — Dinesh has called this the gating factor.
- If procurement pushes longer redline cycles, offer an interim pilot PO (30–45 days) scoped to a single clinic to accelerate adoption.

Attachments included: roi-onepager.pdf, soc2-evidence-summary.xlsx

I'll draft the mutual action plan template (MAP) and share by 11/3 for Ben to review.

— Soojin

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Procurement <procurement@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2026 08:55:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + Mutual Action Plan (Meridian Health / Redwood)

Hi Procurement team — Ben Carter here from Redwood Inference. Per Alex and Soojin, looping in to propose a lightweight MAP to align on timeline and deliverables. Attaching a draft MAP and our demo highlights.

What we propose as the first two milestones: 
1) Security review completed (SOC2 pack + architecture diagram) — target 11/10.
2) Procurement & legal review of MSA + SOW, with negotiations complete and pilot PO issued — target 11/20.

If those targets look unreasonable, tell us which dates work and we'll adapt. A quick procurement kickoff (30m) will help clear the timeline — Alex suggested 11/10 10:00am PT or 11/11 2:00pm PT.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.docx, redwood-demo-deck.pdf

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0303

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick negotiation guidance — Meridian Health (heads-up)

Team — short note before the kickoff:
- If procurement asks for deep indemnity or on-site audit requirements, push back to scoped clauses for the pilot only. For enterprise legal asks, we typically accept limited liability caps tied to fees for pilots.
- Discount posture: we can offer up to 20% on a 12-month reserved commitment, or a 10% pilot discount for a 60-day pilot PO. 
- SLA: be prepared to offer a latency SLO for the Dedicated pool but resist broad uptime credits for hosted pilot.

I'll be available on the kickoff if needed and can help expedite redlines. Good work so far — keep Alex focused on the impact metrics when talking to Maria.

— Marissa
Head of Sales Strategy | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0722
